messages:
Jane (Acme SRE): seeing a big burst of 5xx/gateway timeouts hitting the hosted inference API for our tenant. started ~2024-09-15T13:11Z, ~20-30% error rate, clients getting 504s. can you triage?

Sasha (Support): sorry about that. can you paste one or two request ids and confirm if this is shared-hosted or dedicated?

Jane (Acme SRE): req ids: a1b2c3d4, f5e6g7h8. shared-hosted. we ran a ramp test (internal) then saw timeouts.

deploy-bot: Alert: 504 spike detected for tenant acme-corp between 2024-09-15T13:10:00Z and 2024-09-15T13:21:00Z — error rate 23%.

Devon (Oncall): looking at gateway logs now. Sasha can you confirm routing?

Sasha (Support): confirmed: requests routed to hosted-inference cluster us-west-2, shared pool.

Liam (eng-sre): quick snapshot: HPA metrics for the inference runtime show the custom queue-length metric stayed flat for a bit, then suddenly spiked. KEDA ScaledObject logs show scaler failed to fetch metric samples around 13:09-13:10 due to 401 from the metrics adapter.

billing-bot: Notice: token rotation for tenant acme-corp completed at 2024-09-15T13:08:57Z.

Devon (Oncall): possible clue — if metric adapter auth failed during token rotation, HPA/KEDA may have suppressed scale-up until metrics returned. meanwhile requests queued and gateway timed out.

Amanda (infra): fetching pod events and model-init logs for the scaled replicas.

Amanda (infra): logs snippet:
```
[13:09:12] pod/inference-56f7d    Warning  Unhealthy  kubelet, node-xyz  Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 503
[13:09:45] model-init: downloading weights... elapsed=28.3s
[13:10:18] kv-cache: warming 45s
[13:10:20] pod/inference-56f7d    Normal   Scheduled  pod scheduled
[13:11:05] pod/inference-56f7d    Normal   Pulling    pulling image
[13:12:08] pod/inference-56f7d    Normal   Started    container started
[13:12:40] api-gateway  error  upstream_timeout after 30s
```

Liam (eng-sre): that model-init time + kv-cache warmup means a new replica isn't Ready for ~60s. If scaling only starts after metrics recover, you get a window where traffic overwhelms available replicas -> gateway 504s.

Devon (Oncall): reproduction steps I ran quickly:
1) trigger token rotation for a test tenant (or simulate metrics adapter 401)
2) send a burst: `hey -c 40 -n 400 https://api.redwood.example/v1/inference.generate`
Observed: queued requests increase, KEDA ScaleObject does not create new pods until adapter auth recovers.

Sasha (Support): customer asks for root cause and mitigation options. what can we do short-term?

Liam (eng-sre): short-term mitigations:
- temporarily pin minReplicas for shared pool routes to 2 for high-burst tenants (kubectl patch hpa)
- increase KEDA polling frequency and lower scaleUpCoolDown for critical tenants
- add a prewarm job that keeps one warm replica with model loaded for certain tenants

Devon (Oncall): commands to patch HPA / ScaledObject:
```
kubectl -n hosted-inference patch hpa inference-runtime --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'
kubectl -n hosted-inference annotate scaledobject acme-scaledobject keda.k8s.io/pollingInterval='15' --overwrite
```

Amanda (infra): created temporary workaround: bumped minReplicas on the tenant route and annotated the scaledobject for faster polling. Monitoring now.

billing-bot: Flag: rotating billing tokens were executed around the same time for this tenant. recommend decoupling token rotation from metrics adapter or using a short-lived fallback token.

Jane (Acme SRE): thanks — this matches what we saw. our onboarding test triggered the burst and caught the race. are you planning any permanent fixes?

Liam (eng-sre): long-term options:
- make metrics adapter resilient to token rotation (grace period + retry backoff)
- implement proactive prewarm for common models (keep one instance cold-started per tenant when traffic detected)
- track model-init + kv-warmup in autoscaler signals (custom metric so HPA/KEDA can account for pod readiness delay)

Devon (Oncall): next actions:
- [x] create incident INC-2024-313 (Sasha)
- [x] apply temp minReplicas bump (Amanda)
- [ ] follow-up fix in metrics adapter (Liam)
- [ ] prewarm RFC (product + eng)

Sasha (Support): INC-2024-313 opened and customer notified. will loop in product for prewarm RFC.

Jane (Acme SRE): appreciate the quick triage. we'll hold off on more load until you confirm mitigation.

Liam (eng-sre): monitoring shows error rate dropping back to baseline after the minReplicas bump and adapter token refresh at ~13:13Z. I'll capture full repro steps and add to postmortem.

Devon (Oncall): closing thread for now; will update INC-2024-313 with timeline + root cause. feel free to reopen here. :thumbsup:
